author: Phobiaxx
body:
So, recently( I think recently) fly hacking has been unblocked... now, fly hackers ruin games all over the place, by flying to the monument and breaking, easy peasy. By far, fly hacking is the worst hack, it completely ruins gameplay, for pvp hacks, you could just avoid that player.
However, blocking fly hackers would probably mean NCP rollbacks all over again....
But I'm starting to think the PROS outweigh the CONS.
      Fly hackers are extremely exasperating, they ruin gameplay(soaring to monuments), they ruin pvp(by soaring in with killaura, damaging you, then rushing out before you can even hit...), and they're hard to catch. Well, it's obvious to tell when a fly hacker is hacking... but its hard to get evidence, and mods are busy lots of times, when you /report. For fly hacking, you need video evidence, because it might be chunk error, not much people have recorders..
     One way I get evidence is via stop motion video, AKA spamming F2(:P) But still, stop motion isn't that good, and isn't accepted lots of times, and it spams your screenshot folder...... Also, some fly hackers might have radar on, because I was following one in spec mode, trying to spam F2, but he was like, 'TheRomanTrident, stop following me' o-o Anddd.... one time, once a mod came on, the hacker abruptly stopped, and played legit. o-o
And.... just punishing fly hackers aren't enough, there's just an endless stream, and they ruin much gameplay, and some people want to quit because of it.
Poll(What should funky do?):
A)Leave as is, NCP rollback is super annoying, who cares about a simple noobish fly hacker? ;p
B)Leave as is, but add some Anti-Cheat enhancement that allows mods to find hackers better
C)BLOCK FLY HACKING! IT COMPLETELY RUINS GAMEPLAY!!!
D)OMGOMGOOMGBLOCKITORIRAGEQUIT! :P

Suggestion:The result of the poll
Please leave your votes below! :DDDD
My vote: C

Poll Log:                      -FLY=8
A:4                               +FLY=12
B:4
C:11
D:1
